pin_added.question: Your note, drawn. But 'crowded trades' means two different things and this box can only be one of them — which did you mean?
How do four signals on one name actually become one view of it? This box has been in every description since the first message and has never been opened.

customData.tooltip:
Everything the four scorers emitted, each with a kind, a confidence and a scoring time.

Click through to see who read what.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
The confidence gate. Settled: it is a **gate, not a label** — below 0.70 a Signal still exists internally and reaches nothing a client sees.

Set from the console. Dragging it down does not dim anything; it publishes signals that were previously invisible.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
Below-threshold signals. They exist, they are stored, and no client ever sees them.

Worth noticing: nothing on the dashboard or in any report says how many landed here. An analyst cannot tell a quiet day from a day where forty signals fell just short.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
**A black box, and the oldest one in the project.** Your first description was 'everything gets weighed into a risk model and an aggregator' — this is the weighing, and nobody has ever said how it works.

Four scorers can all fire on one name. Something turns four numbers into one view of that instrument, and whatever it is decides what the whole product says.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
**Mine, shaded so you can delete it.** This is your 'watch out for crowded trades' note, drawn as the smallest thing that could satisfy it.

It sits here because this is the only place it can sit: after signals are combined per name, before that combination is turned into risk. Anywhere earlier and there is nothing to discount; anywhere later and the risk numbers are already wrong.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
Where the Portfolio joins: position sizing, exposure, P&L. Produces the 1-day 95% VaR.

The Macro Calendar also fed in around here — off by default since Aug 2026, so not drawn.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
The risk alert threshold, set from the console.

The dashboard currently reads 2.4%, which is one tenth of a point below this line.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
Surfaces on the dashboard the same day. It does not wait for the monthly Risk Deep-Dive.

Still unmodelled: whether a Risk Alert is a Signal with a kind, or its own concept. Parked by you, deliberately.
